report: Checked all nine candidate lemmas across the five verses. Every difference is one the ASV licenses: הוּא suffixes take my/me/thy/thee/him by case (rule 18); waws take the connective written for each (and/And/Then, rule 14); אֶל takes unto or to as written; מִן takes against (43.1 s009) and from (43.1 s013) as written; בְּ takes because of (43.2, compound rendering under rule 30) and upon (43.4); בּוֹא and יָדָה differ only in mood/frame (jussive let them bring vs cohortative will I go; will I praise vs I shall praise).

Two units with named competing readings were re-read and left standing: 43.3 send out (out kept with שָׁלַח as a phrasal verb on the footing of rule 44's put forth for the same lemma) and 43.4 שִׂמְחַת גִּילִי → joy / exceeding (construct takes the English noun, rectum the attributive under rule 28; margin gloss read and set aside under rule 38). 43.5 Who is added under rule 55: the relative subordinates the appositive nominal, not the suffix's own clause, so rule 18's twice-realized suffix does not reach it, and the copula stays with the construct predicate under rule 20.
The one BSB disagreement (43.1 paragogic he on רִיבָה) is the documented rule 32 convention difference, not an error.
No conventions recorded: the seven repeated notes each restate a contract rule (rules 14, 18, 29). No promotions or amendments: the chapter teaches nothing the contract does not already say.
